event.description: Union closest block-0 pre-FF norm biases 5 and 8
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 37 prior macro-attempts in this family and 447 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0095/micro-0001 at 1672 parameters and 99.010000%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0094/micro-0002 (discard, 97.900000%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of block 0's pre-feed-forward normalization biases: union coordinates 5 and 8, values 0.0430329964 and 0.0470397957 (difference 4.007e-03), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: additive centering has local redundancy distinct from the measured scale boundary, preserving qualification at 1,671 parameters. It is more informative than the next bias union (difference 4.956e-03) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated bias test; scales remain fixed. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
